title.zh: 修订《修正行政法典》第11-A条之第2506-A条的法案
title.en: An Act Amending Section Twenty-Five Hundred Six-A Under Article XI-A of the Revised Administrative Code
title.orig: An Act Amending Section Twenty-Five Hundred Six-A Under Article XI-A of the Revised Administrative Code

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1946/ra_60_1946.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
The first paragraph of section 2506-A under Article XI-A of the Revised Administrative Code is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 2506- A. Powers and duties of the city health officer. — There shall be a city health officer with compensation at the rate of eight thousand four hundred pesos per annum, who shall have charge of the Department of Health and Welfare, and shall be appointed by the President of the Philippines with the consent of the Commission on Appointments of the Congress of the Philippines. He shall have the following general powers and duties:"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: October 17, 1946.
